title: Upcoming School Events:
content:
Upcoming School Events:

- Spring Science Fair: March 15th, 2022, at Lincoln High School Gymnasium. An event where students present science projects.

- Annual Art Showcase: April 22nd, 2022, at Lincoln High School Auditorium. A display of student artwork.

- Community Volunteer Day: May 5th, 2022, at various community locations. A day for students and staff to engage in service projects.
